About Wula Buhuan

Wula Buhuan, located at 13346 Briar Forest Dr, Houston, TX 77077, offers an exceptional dining experience with a focus on bold flavors and quality service. The restaurant is a local favorite for those seeking authentic, flavorful Chinese cuisine in a comfortable and clean setting. While the ambiance is straightforward, it's the delicious food and attentive service that make it stand out.

One of the highlights at Wula Buhuan is the dry pot fish, a dish that's gained popularity for its balance of spice and richness. Another favorite is the spicy crispy shrimp, which has become a must-try for many regulars. Whether you prefer seafood or chicken, the restaurant offers a range of mouthwatering dishes that showcase both traditional and contemporary flavors. For example, their Wulu Chicken, with its bold seasoning, offers a delightful balance of heat without overwhelming the palate.

Customers rave about the juicy and flavorful General Tso chicken, which is perfect for those craving a traditional yet satisfying meal. The spice level can be adjusted, but even a mild version of their dishes tends to retain a potent flavor. The portions are generous, making it a great choice for a filling lunch or dinner.

While it can get crowded, particularly during lunch hours, the service remains consistently attentive and friendly. It's important to note that Wula Buhuan isn't a fast-food joint, so be prepared to take your time and enjoy the experience. The restaurant is perfect for those who appreciate high-quality food, excellent customer service, and a relaxed atmosphere where they can savor their meals at their own pace.

Whether you're stopping by for the first time or returning for a favorite dish, Wula Buhuan offers a memorable dining experience that promises to satisfy your cravings for both spice and flavor.

Reviews

“ Very impressed with this place. We ordered delivery which was very prompt. The sesame chicken was good and very tender. The Wula chicken was extremely good! The Wula had more heat than anticipated, and though my tongue was burning, I couldn’t put it down because it was so flavorful! Both dishes were served with rice and both were 14.00 each. The spring rolls were basic but good. They were an add-on to the order. I will definitely order from this place again. I’m sure they use that heat in their other dishes. ”

Lauri B

“ We decided to venture outside of Chinatown for some of the best Sichuan cuisine in Houston. Upon arriving, we were greeted by tasteful and eloquent decor as well as friendly staff. The tables were equipped with traditional silverware as well as disposable chopsticks. Adequate for our liking. After placing our order, we rolled out our traditional place setting and prepared for a feast. We ordered the Sichuan Crispy Chicken, Sichuan Beef, and Sichuan Jumbo Shrimp. They were very delicious. The jumbo shrimp was the most unique compared to other sichuan restaurants we have eaten at and probably the best of the three dishes. The chicken and beef were on par with other highly rated Sichuan restaurants in Chinatown. The service was very good. Water and rice refills were on point. The waitresses were friendly and attentive. If you want to try something outside of Chinatown or simply don't want to deal with Houston traffic, this is a nice little gem in the world of sichuan cuisine. ”

Jerry W

“ Stopped by while my tire was getting fixed across the street. The menu has a wide selection of dishes. I went with a beef dish that was delicious and had a nice spicy burn. Service was fast and attentive. A staff member came by to ask if I needed more rice, which I really appreciated. The dining area was clean and nicely decorated. I didn't see a lunch menu. This place would be great to go with others so several dishes could be tasted. Note only non-alcoholic drinks are served. ”

Chandran Kumar

“ Had a great experience eating here. I ordered mapo tofu and wula chicken. Tofu was spicy, but not too spicy. A good balance. Rice was very good too. ”

Koh Kobayashi

“ Tried the dry pot fish and spicy chicken cubes, both were delicious. Service was excellent. Atmosphere was nothing fancy, but comfortable and clean. I'll definitely be eating here again. ”

David Oakes

“ So the very first time I went here, I had their spicy crispy shrimp and to this day this is my go to order from this restaurant. I tried a couple of other things and they were good tOo, but those shrimp are to die for! Definitely recommend! ”

Kirill Abdullaev

“ Small place but the food is what packs the punch. Outstanding Asian cuisine, the best I have had in this city. Casual atmosphere for a sit down location. I have yet to try a dish I have not liked here. ”

Juan

“ I have been here a couple times during lunch. The first time I had a traditional General Tso chicken, which was juicy and super yummy. I went back this week and ordered the Wulu Chicken (picture below). I asked them to hold back on the spice, but woooo, it was still spicy. However, it was some of the best tasting chicken dishes I have every had. Very flavorful but not heavy or too sweet. They tend to get crowded with the locals, so just remember it is not fast food. Service was good and very kind. ”

Frank Beck
